summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing completed for HRL Forge AI. All 31 pytest cases passed (health, auth, knowledge base, projects CRUD, AI generate + explain, history, settings, chat with Claude, admin RBAC guard). Frontend E2E via Playwright: landing renders, registration succeeds and redirects to /app/dashboard, dashboard stats render, Workspace generates real Arduino code from Claude Sonnet 4.6 in ~22s, all 6 output tabs render, Save creates a project, all sidebar nav pages load without console errors, logout redirects to /login.

ui_bugs.issue: Card shows '4 TEMPLATES' but GET /api/v1/templates returns 8 templates. Likely a slice/limit in Dashboard render or stale state. Verify templates.length calculation and any interim filtering.

action_items: Investigate Dashboard 'Templates' stat card showing 4 instead of 8 (backend confirms 8 templates). May be a transient loading race — check useEffect fetch or slicing in Dashboard.jsx.

Documentation nav item uses data-testid='nav-docs' (per AppShell.jsx line 29 id:'docs'), while review_request mentioned 'nav-documentation'. Consistent — testing agent's expectation was wrong. No fix needed.
critical_code_review_comments: pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope` which broke session-scoped register fixture (duplicate email 400s across workers). Worked around with -n 0. Recommend making auth fixtures worker-scoped (unique email per worker) if parallel is required.

Board/Language selects are shadcn Radix (button role=combobox), not native <select>. Playwright's select_option cannot drive them; UI tests must click trigger + option. Defaults were preselected so generation still worked without explicit selection.
JWT_SECRET in backend/.env is committed plain-text — fine for dev, must be rotated in production.
generate + chat endpoints are synchronous Claude calls (10-30s). Consider streaming or background job for better UX.
test_credentials: Registered fresh users at runtime: hrl.qa+{ts}@myhrl.in / Forge2026! (backend) and hrl.qa.ui+{ts}@myhrl.in / Forge2026! (frontend)
seed_data_creation: None. Backend seed_all() runs at lifespan startup and populated 8 boards, 8 templates, and sensors/modules/protocols idempotently.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs cleanly with `pytest -n 0` (serial). pytest.ini's `-n 2 --dist loadscope` breaks the shared auth fixture — either invoke with `-n 0` or rewrite fixture to use unique per-worker email. Real Claude calls consume Emergent credits (~2-3 per full run: generate + explain + chat). Admin RBAC guard verified via 403 for role='user'; full admin flow untested — promote a user to admin in Mongo shell if needed.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Minor Dashboard templates stat (shows 4 vs 8) is a low-priority frontend discrepancy — repro: register, land on /app/dashboard, observe stat card. Mitigation: inspect Dashboard.jsx templates fetch and rendering; ensure templates state uses full API list length without slice.
